name: Traitor Guardsmen Squad
loadout:
The Traitor Sergeant is equipped with: corrupted pistol; close combat weapon.

Every Traitor Guardsman is equipped with: lasgun; close combat weapon.

faction.name: Dark Pacts
faction.description_html:
If your Army Faction is HERETIC ASTARTES, each time a unit with this ability is selected to shoot or fight, it can make a Dark Pact. If it does, it must first take a Leadership test before any effects of that Dark Pact are resolved; if that test is failed, that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds. Then, select one of the following abilities for that unit’s weapons to gain until the end of the phase:
  • [LETHAL HITS]
  • [SUSTAINED HITS 1]

datasheet.name: Twisted Defence Force
datasheet.description_html: While this unit is within range of an objective marker, each time a ranged attack targets this unit, models in this unit have the Benefit of Cover against that attack.

wargear_options.description:
Up to 3 Traitor Guardsmen can each have their lasgun replaced with one of the following (duplicates are not allowed):
  • 1 Cultist grenade launcher
  • 1 flamer
  • 1 meltagun
  • 1 plasma gun
  • 1 Cultist sniper rifle

The Traitor Sergeant’s close combat weapon can be replaced with one of the following:
  • 1 chainsword
  • 1 power weapon
The Traitor Sergeant’s corrupted pistol can be replaced with 1 boltgun.
